item.title: Fechi Chichi! ~Kyonyuu Sensei no Yuuwaku Jugyou~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Luchs
  • 発売日: 2010-01-29
  • スコア: 6.970000000000001/10 (13 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ふぇちちち！～巨乳先生の誘惑授業～
  • 英語名: Fechi Chichi! Kyonyuu Sensei no Yuuwaku Jugyou

あらすじ

Toru is just an average student. One day, he meets, Nozomi, a Kyonyu classroom teacher. She used to be his home tutor. Yes, he was in love with her…. He is surprised to hear that she lives next door to him! Nozomi loves Toru as well, but she can do nothing…. The one who breaks this deadlock is Satsuki, who is also a teacher and lives with Nozomi. “I like him…. I’ll have sex with him….” Her word changes Toru’s school life….

Admit it, you already know the rest…

item.title: GHQ ~Chihiro Gakuen Ura Gakuensai~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Luchs
  • 発売日: 2002-10-18
  • スコア: 6.32/10 (5 人評価)
  • 日本語名: GHQ～千尋学園裏学園祭～
  • 英語名: GHQ Chihiro Gakuen Ura Gakuensai

别名

  • ＧＨＱ－千尋学園「裏」学園祭－

あらすじ

A quiz-based game set in a secret school tournament where the winner gets her wish fulfilled. What the girls don’t know, however, is that the losers of each round will have to pay with their body…

You can choose one of the 5 playable protagonists and try to get her to the ending. Each round you win you can see the “punishment” of one of the other girls (rape or other forms of sexual humiliation). Losing on the final round also grants you a “game over rape” scene with the girl you’ve chosen as protagonist.
